threads.label: Iran War Powers Resolution

threads.label: House of the Dragon Season 3

threads.label: Amazon Prime Video Ads Without Refunds

threads.label: PFAS Forever Chemicals Breakdown
threads.summary: Chemists reported UV light alone can break down PFAS forever chemicals in water without reagents; new study revealed intense UV light destroys PFAS by generating hydrogen radicals. Appeared on two days in June 2026.

threads.label: South Korea Chip Investment

threads.label: PCE Inflation and Fed Rate Cuts

threads.label: TPS for Haitians and Syrians
